task:
Use Qiongli to draft two independent, publication-style critical discussion sections from the supplied public papers. This is new substantive drafting with source checking, followed by a language pass and meaning review. It is not a policy recommendation, exhaustive literature review, or proofreading of a settled author conclusion.

A. Ecology: What does Hallmann et al. (2017) establish about declining flying-insect biomass in protected areas, and what follows for interpreting protection and possible drivers? Explain how sampling, measurements and model results bear on the answer. Write a sustained argument that a reader can follow across paragraphs.
B. Social policy: What does Dwyer et al. (2023) establish about cash transfers as an approach to reducing homelessness, and how do its different outcomes and study components bear on that interpretation? Explain the evidential connections rather than cataloguing results.

For EACH task deliver a Chinese section of 1100–1500 non-whitespace Unicode code points and an English section of 700–900 whitespace-delimited words. Exclude headings and standalone source-anchor citations from counts. These are parallel versions for different readers: preserve the substantive answer and consequential evidence/qualifications while using natural academic syntax in each language. Use connected paragraphs, not bullets or an outline. Do not force a paragraph count. Include useful source-specific detail, clear reasoning and a supported ending without filling the text with repeated caveats. Cite precise inspected PDF page locations with anchors like 〔Hallmann2017 p.11〕 or 〔Dwyer2023 pp.3–4〕. Do not cite uninspected supplements or other papers as if you read them. Inspect original figure/table pages for visual claims. Do not invent findings or mechanisms.

Use exactly these top-level headings: '## Ecology — 中文', '## Ecology — English', '## Social policy — 中文', '## Social policy — English'. Return the four final sections only. No work log, checklists, review notes or counts. Do not browse, fetch material, write files or call external services. You may read supplied files and count a draft in memory. Read guidance and sources in bounded ranges; a whole-corpus dump is unnecessary.

criteria.basis: Inspect complete output units and original source locations. Passage-level quality; no hedge-count, sentence-count or lexical-blacklist score. A tie or mixed preference is valid. Distinguish definite defects from stylistic preferences and unavailable supplemental evidence.
ecology_checks: Biomass is not species richness or individual counts. Location-year samples are not 63 continuous site time series. Seasonal and mid-summer model estimates have distinct meaning. Regional sampled protected sites do not establish global decline or protection causal ineffectiveness. Measured covariates failing to explain the trend do not eliminate their roles or establish an unmeasured cause. Model/counterfactual distinctions remain identifiable.
social_checks: Shelter-cluster allocation and screening define inference scope. Preregistered one-month cognitive/wellbeing comparisons and exploratory yearly housing estimates must not become a single confirmatory success or a null that erases housing evidence. Housing categories are not binary complements. Cost savings are a model calculation not a universal budget promise. Null spending difference is not equivalence or measured no-risk. Public-attitude experiments do not establish recipients mechanism or durable behavior. Claims about supplements require actually provided evidence.
language_checks: Read continuous passages, not isolated corrected sentences. Necessary source limits belong at the claim they qualify; repetitive metacommentary can damage prose. Meaningful qualifications survive the conclusion and translation. No automatic penalty for cautious or direct words.
criteria.comparison: Compare flow, explanation, fidelity and bilingual expression separately. Do not infer identity or score speed/length alone.

defensive_writing.coordinator_initial_target: Successive baseline paragraphs often end by delimiting an inference; some Chinese duration wording is indirect. These were improvement targets rather than established factual failures.
defensive_writing.blind_review_result: Most qualifications constrain different claims and are necessary, not repetitive disclaimers. Both versions directly state the supported answer. Do not treat the result as evidence for indiscriminate caveat removal.
defensive_writing.rule_scope: Carry already established scope through precise terms, restate consequential limits when the inference changes, and keep J2 meaning-preservation boundaries.

limitations: One fresh writer per guidance version, same configured model and a fresh anonymous same-model reviewer; no subject-expert or author review.
The candidate rules respond to observed baseline phrasing on these sources; this is a diagnostic before/after comparison, not a held-out generalization test.
The source packet is fixed to two papers and supplied main-text images. No full literature or supplemental-data verification.
No model-quality, speed, installed-Plugin, cross-Host or readiness promotion follows from these local checks.
raw_preservation: Raw answers and review are unchanged. Public PDF/text/image and local rollouts stay outside Git; temporary auth links removed and observed subprocess groups reaped.
